svg.title: Splunk SOC Lab — annotated 06-raw-file-creation-audit-id
svg.desc: One shared Auditd ID links five companion records. PATH and successful SYSCALL together support one file creation; record count is not operation count.

g.text: ONE AUDIT ID · FIVE COMPANION RECORDS
PATH (CREATE) + PATH (PARENT) + CWD + successful SYSCALL + PROCTITLE ≠ five separate file creations
